summary: All 7 features tested and VERIFIED WORKING: 1) Dashboard 'My Income >' link navigates to /my-income, 2) Dashboard 'My Expenses >' link navigates to /my-expenses, 3) Back button on /job-income uses navigate(-1) correctly, 4) Back button on /business-income uses navigate(-1) correctly, 5) Back button on /self-employed-income uses navigate(-1) correctly, 6) Remember Me saves credentials to localStorage on login and prefills them on return visit, 7) Net Worth card text is visible (Total Net Worth, Growing badge, Assets/Investments/Cash labels)

issues: Console shows HTML hydration warnings about <span> inside <option> and <select> - non-critical React dev warnings

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 user-requested changes verified: 1) My Income/Expenses navigation links in Monthly Cashflow widget work correctly, 2) Back buttons on all income form pages use navigate(-1) and respect browser history, 3) Remember Me stores {email, password} in localStorage key 'moneyssutra_remember' and prefills on return, 4) Net Worth card uses text-shadow and font-semibold for white text visibility on teal background.

my_income_link.details: Dashboard Monthly Cashflow widget has 'My Income >' link (data-testid=cashflow-view-my-income) that navigates to /my-income

my_expenses_link.details: Dashboard Monthly Cashflow widget has 'My Expenses >' link (data-testid=cashflow-view-my-expenses) that navigates to /my-expenses

job_income_back_button.details: Back button on /job-income uses navigate(-1). Tested: /add-income -> /job-income -> back -> returns to /add-income (not hardcoded /my-job)

business_income_back_button.details: Back button on /business-income uses navigate(-1). Tested: /add-income -> /business-income -> back -> returns to /add-income

self_employed_income_back_button.details: Back button on /self-employed-income uses navigate(-1). Tested: /add-income -> /self-employed-income -> back -> returns to /add-income

remember_me_save.details: Login with Remember Me checked saves {email, password} to localStorage key 'moneyssutra_remember'

remember_me_prefill.details: On login page load, if localStorage has 'moneyssutra_remember', credentials are prefilled and checkbox is checked

networth_card_visibility.details: Net Worth card shows white text with text-shadow on teal background. 'Total Net Worth', 'Growing' badge, 'Assets', 'Investments', 'Cash' labels all visible
